name: Fleet Improver
tagline: Nightly audit of your bot fleet: tokens in, value out
description: Once a day it grades every bot you run on a simple question: how many tokens does each one burn to return useful work? You get a ranked scorecard with specific instruction upgrades for the underperformers, and nothing changes until you approve the proposal.
author: rzubiran
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
